issue_question: How should Programme, ProgrammeInstance, InstitutionOffering and DiscoveryProgramme be reconciled?
relevant_evidence: Early business meaning; domain-model evolution; reversed ProgrammeOffering/Campus rejection; Sep18 discovery proposal.
historical_conclusion: Programme began as institution-specific study offering; later abstract Programme + ProgrammeInstance split concrete context; Sep18 proposed InstitutionOffering + DiscoveryProgramme.
current_assessment: Use Institution Offering as preferred business/product term for the source-faithful institution-specific offering. Discovery Programme is a distinct StudyNexus-curated discovery concept. ProgrammeInstance remains historical technical/domain language for contextual variation and is not automatically a product term.
current_scope_implication: Institution offering and discovery classification are MVP.
disposition: Carry into canonical Product Discovery; final UL may refine subordinate offering-context vocabulary.
remaining_assumption: Representative multi-campus/multi-mode data may prove a stable subordinate Offering Variant/Context concept is needed.
affected_product_concept_capability: Institution Offering; Discovery Programme; Programme; ProgrammeInstance

current_scope_implication: MVP — explicit assumption required.
disposition: Preserve optional classification in canonical product model.
remaining_assumption: Owner/UL ratification remains desirable; exact classification cardinality/schemes remain for later modeling.
